changes.text: Removed pricing, dollar amounts, and cost-lever guidance from self-host documentation. Operational notes about serverless auto-pause and cold starts remain without commercial framing.
Tasks list pages through full history (no 10,000-row cap).
Week view supports multiple in-progress draft rows at once.
Google Calendar disconnect/reconnect; Pull missed events checks every [tag] in an event title.
App version at the bottom of the left nav, with a "New" badge when a new version is first seen.
Versions page listing release notes (linked from the nav version).
Editor:Tyme role: create and edit projects, without sharing availability with team (Manager+).
Submit page: early submission for the current (or future) month when time is already entered.
Duration storage limits enforced consistently across manual entry and timer completion.
Reports page has a dedicated filter row.
Stopwatch sessions UX, project autocomplete (infinite scroll / open upward), work-item lock when any session is submitted.
Task list column alignment; all-day duration uses a tooltip instead of a conflicting icon.
Sidebar stray horizontal scrollbar next to the version number.
Quieted noisy EF Core SQL command logging in the Function worker.
Removed the SQL keepalive timer that blocked serverless database auto-pause.
Changelog process documented for developers; CI can gate version bumps on changelog entries.
Tasks All / Week / Project views with week entry grids and duration UX.
User default start time (08:00) and workspace TymeTrackTimeOfDay setting.
Stopwatch session create-duration flow and browser Tasks page preferences.
Time of day parsing for bare hour+meridiem (e.g. 9P) and HH:mm:ss under any culture.
Initial public My.Workspace product baseline.
